sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Distribution of Certified Civil Aircraft Rotables and Avionics Surplus

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia - Bogotá D.C. (Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil_Law (codified commercial and administrative law with supervisory enforcement by Superintendencies and an effective arbitration framework)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012, investment chapter)
Alianza del Pacífico Framework Agreement (Mexico, Chile, Peru; in force 2015)
Colombia-Switzerland BIT within EFTA-Colombia FTA (in force 2011)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526/1999 (creation of UIAF), Ley 1121/2006 (money laundering and terrorist financing), Ley 1258/2008 (S.A.S. legal framework), Decreto 830/2021 (beneficial owner definition), Resolución DIAN 000164/2022 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB), Circular Básica Jurídica of Superintendencia de Sociedades Capítulo X (SAGRILAFT), Ley 2195/2022 (anti-corruption and corporate transparency), and sector-specific aviation import/export rules under Ley 105/1993, Decreto 260/2004, and UAEAC airworthiness requirements for commercial aircraft parts.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (the RUB registry is confidential and accessible only to DIAN, UIAF, and authorized supervisory authorities; it is not publicly searchable)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney for incorporation formalities (poder especial)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign notary of each shareholder or a Colombian notary if executed domestically
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille via the issuing state's competent authority; Colombia has been a party to the Hague Apostille Convention since 2001. Consular legalization is required only for documents originating from non-Hague jurisdictions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy of each individual shareholder and certificate of existence and legal representation of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry, notary, or consular authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille through the competent authority or consular legalization before the Consulate of Colombia

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed private incorporation document of the S.A.S., UBO self-declaration, and SAGRILAFT compliance attestation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notaría Pública in Colombia and/or Cámara de Comercio
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarial certification and Chamber of Commerce filing; no apostille required for documents intended solely for the Colombian registry.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and UBOs against (i) OFAC SDN and consolidated Non-SDN lists, (ii) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, (iii) EU and UK HM Treasury consolidated lists, (iv) Colombia's UIAF financial intelligence indicators and domestic terrorist, narcotics, and corruption lists, (v) Superintendencia de Sociedades enforcement and disqualification records, and (vi) local judicial and police records; enhanced due diligence applies to non-resident UBOs and politically exposed persons; ongoing monitoring and suspicious transaction reporting under Circular Básica Jurídica Capítulo X and UIAF Resolution guidelines.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social - RUES (www.rues.org.co) through the competent local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), with validation against DIAN RUT and Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio records
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Spanish or in a widely recognized foreign language provided all tokens are in Latin characters and phonetically pronounceable in Spanish; the proposed name must be distinguishable from existing registered trade names and trademarks in the same commercial activity; descriptive tokens such as 'AVIATION', 'AEROSPACE', or 'AIRCRAFT PARTS' are acceptable when combined with a distinct core denomination.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The RUES name reservation is valid for 30 calendar days (some chambers apply 30 business days) and is not statutorily extendable; after expiry the applicant must submit a new search. Upon rejection, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición with the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days, and if denied, a recurso de apelación before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within 5 business days. Parallel alternative: file a new application with a different distinctive token and conduct a trademark search on the SIC public database to avoid infringement.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible: a pure virtual or PO-box address is not accepted by the Cámara de Comercio. A designated physical office, serviced office, or coworking space within the same chamber jurisdiction is accepted provided it enables personal service of process, display of company identification, and access for official inspections. A landlord or operator consent letter and a lease agreement are required for registration of the matrícula mercantil.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-heightened: approximately 15-20% baseline probability of an unannounced verification visit by the Cámara de Comercio within the first 12 months for newly incorporated S.A.S. entities, increasing to 25-30% if the registered office is shared with three or more unrelated firms or if the director is a non-resident foreign person. DIAN may also conduct on-site substance checks during RUT activation and customs validation of aviation parts imports.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and homonymy certificate (prevalidación del nombre) via RUES
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory chamber user fee per local tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Trademark and trade-name clearance search against the SIC public database
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; fixed attorney fee, no official SIC fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of the S.A.S. private incorporation document, by-laws, and UBO piercing analysis with SAGRILAFT annex
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; fixed professional fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of corporate powers of attorney and optional protocolization of the S.A.S. private document
Apostilles of foreign shareholder documents (estimated 5 documents at USD 10 each)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs / authorized notary in country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory or fixed government fee per apostilled document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Cámara de Comercio registration and matrícula mercantil including certificate of existence and legal representation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff; fixed minimum plus progression based on subscribed capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Impuesto de registro (registration tax on incorporation act)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Bogotá D.C. Treasury / Departamento de Cundinamarca
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tax of approximately 0.7% of subscribed capital, assumed on USD 10,000 of initial capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: DIAN RUT issuance and RUB (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales) filing including UBO verification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Free statutory procedure; external professional compliance fee may apply

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SAGRILAFT policy implementation and PEP/sanctions screening setup (software setup and policy adoption)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; one-time setup fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VUCE and UAEAC registration and application handling for import/export of commercial aviation spares
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo / Unidad Administrativa Especial de Aeronáutica Civil
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for professional filing; official VUCE online filing has no statutory fee, but UAEAC concept fees may apply when required

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Colombian Commercial Code (Código de Comercio) and Law 1258 of 2008 on Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas (S.A.S.), particularly Articles 1-6, 19-20, 34-35, and 46 (registration with Mercantile Registry).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the principal corporate domicile, Mercantile Registry Division
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Private Instrument of Incorporation) registered with the Mercantile Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital for an S.A.S.; capital is freely set by shareholders in the bylaws. Cash contributions may be deferred up to two years, and in-kind contributions must be fully paid at incorporation. No escrow account requirement applies under Law 1258 of 2008.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. The shareholders and initial board members resolve that: 1. The incorporation document dated [date] is ratified under Law 1258 of 2008. 2. The registered office is adopted at [address], [city], Colombia, within the jurisdiction of the Chamber of Commerce. 3. The share subscription is approved: the subscribed capital is COP [amount] divided into [number] nominative shares issued to [shareholders], with payment terms as set out in the bylaws. 4. The following officers are appointed: [CEO] as chief executive officer, [Secretary] as corporate secretary, and [Tax Auditor] as statutory auditor where applicable. 5. The appointed officers are authorised to execute registration forms and obtain the company's NIT.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the proposed domicile, online SIVE portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the Chamber's online services, complete the homonym search to verify name availability, and file a name reservation request. Submit the required dossiers and process the payment. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 30 calendar days during which incorporation must be filed.
required_dossiers: Completed name reservation application form
National ID or Passport copy of each founding shareholder
Proposed corporate name with up to three alternates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or already registered, the applicant may submit up to three alternative names; no additional fee is charged for one re-submission within the same working day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public or Cámara de Comercio registration desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución containing identification of shareholders, corporate purpose, capital distribution, board structure, and audit rights. Execute the document with notarized signatures of all shareholders and initial managers. If assets are contributed, require a notarial deed to evidence contribution and posting.
required_dossiers: Draft bylaws including articles of incorporation
Identity proofs of shareholders and managers
Notarized signatures of witnesses and notary
Proof of name reservation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or the Chamber finds missing mandatory clauses, shareholders can execute an amendment to the incorporation document; a deficiency notice allows 30 days to cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (e-registration module or corporate registry desk)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation document, registration form, name reservation, and payment of the registration fee to the Chamber of Commerce. The Chamber checks legality, records the company in the Mercantile Registry, and issues the Certificate of Existence and Representation (Certificado de Cámara de Comercio) and a preliminary RUT (UTF) if requested.
required_dossiers: Signed incorporation document with bylaws
Name reservation certificate
RUT preliminary form
Identification documents of shareholders and legal representatives
Notarial power of attorney if acting through a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues a query, correct the identified omissions and resubmit within 30 days; determine if an additional fee applies. An appeal may be filed with the Chamber's administrative division.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and NIT Acquisition before DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (MUISCA virtual office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request registration with DIAN to obtain the NIT, update the RUT, choose the organization legal status, and establish tax obligations. Upload the registration certificate, incorporation proof, and information of the legal representative.
required_dossiers: Authentic certificate of representation issued by Cámara de Comercio
RUT application (Formulario de Registro Único Tributario)
Legal representative identification and proof of authority
Copy of the incorporated bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Amend RUT registration online if rejected; attach missing documentation and resubmit. If difficulties persist, request DIAN telephone assistance or obtain tax advisor intervention.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Books Stamp and Social Security Employer Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Libros de Comercio) and social security administrators (EPS, ARL, Caja de Compensación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company's accounting, minute, and shareholder registration books with the Chamber of Commerce. Register as an employer with the payroll system, ARL (occupational risk insurance), and the chosen Caja de Compensación for family allowances. Submit the initial payroll with zero employees if no staff is yet hired.
required_dossiers: Physical or electronic books to be stamped (Libro de Registro de Accionistas, Libro de Actas, Libro de Contabilidad)
Company certificate (Certificado de Cámara de Comercio)
NIT registration certificate
Legal representative ID
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Cámara de Comercio refuses to stamp the books due to incomplete data, update the legal documentation and request a review. Social security enrollment can be rectified within the following monthly cycle.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: UAEAC – Unidad Administrativa Especial de Aeronáutica Civil
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Comercializador de Material Aeronáutico (Aviation Material Distributor Registration) and applicable Operation Specification for a Distribution Center

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) with coordination of local Corporaciones Autónomas Regionales (CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III – Registration (no full EIA Report) applicable for wholesale distribution activities; assumed low environmental risk.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Must comply with Resolution 909 of 2008 and Resolution 2254 of 2017 for air emissions and VOCs; for wastewater discharges, abide by Resolution 1541 of 2013 and applicable local disharge permits; hazardous waste, if generated from damaged or surplus avionics, must be declared under Decree 4741 of 2005 and disposed of through licensed hazardous waste carriers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Certificado de Bomberos) is required for the warehouse facility; structural load inspection of storage racks and shelving must be certified by a licensed engineer; occupational health and safety program must be registered with ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales) and workplace readiness verified by ARL inspection.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - Colombian national tax and customs administration. Official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional platform: MUISCA (muisca.dian.gov.co); 'Sede Electrónica' for electronic filing, RUT management and e-invoice validation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: STEP 1: Incorporate the S.A.S. under Law 1258/2008 by private document, register with the competent Cámara de Comercio and obtain the Certificado de Cámara de Comercio. STEP 2: File the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) application with DIAN via the MUISCA online portal or at a DIAN 'punto de contacto'; non-resident shareholders must appoint a resident legal/tax representative under a notarized power of attorney. STEP 3: DIAN issues the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) and a formal RUT certificate classifying the company as 'responsable de IVA' and merchant. STEP 4: Obtain a DIAN-recognized digital signature ('firma electrónica') required for mandatory electronic filing and e-invoicing. A foreign seller transacting in its own name for a Colombian taxable nexus or permanent establishment must likewise obtain a NIT/RUT through an appointed agent before doing business.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: Colombian-resident S.A.S. (Law 1258/2008) is a separate taxpaying entity with no pass-through status. It is taxed on worldwide income at the 35% corporate income tax rate for tax years 2023-2025; no check-the-box election exists to be treated as a flow-through. Municipal industry-and-commerce tax (ICA) applies to trading gross income but is deductible for corporate income tax. Dividends remitted to foreign shareholders are subject to dividend withholding tax, subject to treaty relief. Territorial concessions are available only through the statutory regimes described in the elections field.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election is available. Statutory options include: (1) SIMPLE regime (Arts. 905-922 E.T.) for qualifying small taxpayers (gross income ≤ 100,000 UVT, approx. COP 4.98 billion in 2025), substituting ordinary income tax/VAT obligations; (2) Zona Franca user status authorized by DIAN, taxing qualifying operating income at 20% (Law 1004/2005, Decree 2147/2016); (3) Colombian Holding Company (CHC) regime under Art. 895 E.T., exempting qualifying foreign dividends and capital gains where the S.A.S. holds ≥10% of foreign entities, reports ≥50% foreign-source assets or income, and meets economic substance rules; and (4) fiscal consolidation (Arts. 885-897 E.T.) for Colombian groups. Hybrid mismatch rules introduced by Law 2277/2022 are mandatory and non-elective.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA - Impuesto al Valor Agregado), governed by the Estatuto Tributario, Articles 420-535.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 - no statutory turnover threshold for the ordinary IVA regime. Any person making taxable sales, rendering taxable services or importing goods must register in the RUT and be classified as 'responsable de IVA' from the first transaction. The only quantitative threshold is for the optional SIMPLE regime: gross income ≤ 100,000 UVT (approx. COP 4,980,000,000 for 2025; 2025 UVT = COP 49,799).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta - FE) applies to all IVA-responsible taxpayers. Under DIAN Resolutions 000012/2023 and 000165/2023, each FE must be transmitted in XML to DIAN's MUISCA/Sede Electrónica platforms through a registered technology provider or DIAN's free web issuer (with API integration), validated in real time, and embedded with the CUFE/CUDS code and QR digital-stamping element. The invoice is cleared online before issuance to the buyer; electronic equivalent documents are required for certain purchases from non-responsible parties. Taxpayers must transmit acceptance/rejection events and retain records for at least 5 years. Export invoices must reference the customs export declaration.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Article 481 E.T. zero-rates exports of tangible goods (e.g., surplus commercial aircraft rotables and avionics) and qualifying cross-border services. Conditions for goods exports: (i) the S.A.S. is registered as an exporter with DIAN; (ii) a definitive export is completed under the Colombian customs regime with a valid Declaración de Exportación; (iii) the buyer is non-resident and title/passage occurs outside Colombia; (iv) payment is received in foreign currency through the Colombian foreign-exchange market. Zero-rating permits full recovery or refund of input IVA attributable to export purchases. Sales of spare parts and supplies to international air carriers for international operations may also qualify for zero-rating under Article 481(f). Services-export zero-rating requires additional documentary compliance under Decree 1625/2016, Arts. 1.6.1.12.13-1.6.1.12.20 (foreign recipient, use exclusively abroad, evidence of FX settlement).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación Definitiva (customs export declaration issued through DIAN/VUCE electronic systems)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Colombia
Factura Electrónica de Venta de Exportación (electronic export invoice containing CUFE and referencing the export declaration)
Declaración de Cambio / Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an authorized foreign-exchange intermediary
Certificate of Origin, where preferential tariff treatment is claimed or where DIAN requires it
Registro Nacional de Exportadores (valid DIAN exporter registration)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN verifies every export VAT refund claim (solicitud de devolución y/o compensación) and may audit the supporting customs, transport and foreign-exchange documentation for up to 5 years after the annual return due date. If a refund is determined improper, Article 670 E.T. imposes a penalty equal to 20% of the refunded amount, plus daily default interest under Article 634 E.T. and monetary indexation under Article 867 E.T.; overstated refunds may also trigger the 100% 'inexactitud' penalty under Article 647 E.T. Falsified export declarations, fabricated bills of lading or simulated FE transactions carry criminal liability under Law 1762/2015 (customs fraud and smuggling), including asset-seizure and money-laundering exposure. DIAN may additionally offset clawbacks against future refunds, suspend the exporter's registration, and reassess underlying transactions by presumption where commercial substance is lacking.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) acting through the foreign exchange market administration and the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, with policy coordination from the Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo for export-related matters
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is fully convertible for current-account transactions, including trade-related settlements through an authorized foreign exchange market intermediary ('IMC'). Capital-account transactions, including inbound foreign direct investment into a Colombian S.A.S., are permitted but require prior or subsequent registration with Banco de la República through the foreign exchange declaration forms. Profit and dividend remittance to non-resident shareholders is unrestricted after the applicable tax form and the corresponding foreign exchange declaration have been filed. Surplus commercial aircraft parts distribution, classified as ISIC 4659, constitutes a goods-import/export activity for exchange purposes, and therefore all payments for imports and collections from exports must be channelled through the official foreign exchange market. The sale of used/certified aircraft rotables is not treated as a financial flow in itself and does not require a separate convertibility license; however, the underlying trade must evidence LC, commercial invoice, and customs declaration to support the exchange transaction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods exports, the exporter must channel the full export proceeds to Colombia through an authorized foreign exchange intermediary within the statutory period of six (6) months after the date of shipment, or within the period expressly extended by Banco de la República in case of documented collective financing cycles. The proceeds must either be converted to COP at a market-determined rate through the IMC, or be credited to a foreign currency deposit account held with a local commercial bank supervised by the Superintendencia Financiera. The exporter must present the corresponding 'Declaración de Cambio' (Exchange Declaration) to the IMC, together with the airborne export or customs exit certificate, commercial invoice, bill of lading or airway bill, and proof of payment. There is no legal mandatory percentage conversion ratio; the entire export value is subject to the channeling obligation, but the exporter is free to hold the foreign currency in a local foreign-currency account if such account has been duly opened with an authorized bank. The use of compensating arrangements for aviation parts swaps is permissible only under a prior approval from the Banco de la República's exchange office.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account for foreign investment contribution and Operational multicurrency Account
Operational Account and Foreign Investment Registration Account
Operational Current Account and Preferential Export Proceeds Account
Corporate Operational Account and ITFC/Pre-finance escrow support
Operational Account for trade collections and disbursements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for the physical Colombian treasury layer. Colombian law reserves the taking of deposits, issuance of payment instruments, and the provision of settlement/fx services to supervised banking institutions. Offshore Financial Technology companies and Electronic Money Institutions cannot independently hold COP or settle through the Central Clearing System (CENIT) or the ACH system. An EMI, such as an EU-based e-money institution or a U.S. Money Transmitter, may be used only as a complementary invoicing or cross-border collection gateway in USD/GBP/EUR, provided the ultimate settlement enters Colombia through a local authorized bank. Any attempt to structure liquidity through an unlicensed EMI would trigger enhanced scrutiny by the Superintendencia Financiera and potentially classify the operation as an illegal handling of public funds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical attendance. Under current Colombian AML/CFT standards and the 'Conozca a su Cliente' regime applicable to legal entities having beneficial owners that are natural persons, the legal representative, the compliance officer, and all final beneficial owners appear in person before the bank's risk officer to execute the account opening. Remote videoconference interviews are accepted only as supplementary to the in-person meeting and are never sufficient alone. A notarized and apostilled board resolution appointing the lawful representative, a valid Colombian tax ID (RUT), a Chamber of Commerce certificate with less than 30 days issue, and certified personal identification of each director are essential. The bank will physically verify the domicile of the legal representative in Colombia and any place of business of the S.A.S.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity in a Colombian S.A.S. with multiple foreign shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete and current register of ultimate beneficial ownership, including certified copies of passports, apostilled birth certificates or corporate formation documents, a Legal Entity Crystal transparency certificate, constitutional documents, a valid shareholder ledger, and the formal UBO declaration required by Colombian bank compliance. All shareholders above 10% must be physically verifiable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of verifiable physical custody or provenance of surplus civil aircraft parts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: FAA Form 8130-3, EASA Form 1, or equivalent airworthiness approval tags, chain-of-custody documents, purchase invoices, export certificates, customs entry forms, IATA or CargoX air waybills, storage lease agreements in qualified aircraft parts warehouses, and proof of end-user or maintenance organization license.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds and wealth origin for the initial capital injection from non-resident investors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements for the last three years, covered-by-actual-bank-statement investor wealth statements, tax returns reflecting declared income, share purchase agreements with valuation documentation, and certified legal opinion regarding the compliance of the investor under its home jurisdiction's anti-money laundering controls.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential exposure to sanctions or restrictive lists on counterparties or escrow agents
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A due-diligence report on every counterparty, including OFAC/UN/EU/Colombia Consolidado list checks, negative-news database search results, passport or tax ID copies, commercial registry certificates, and export-control authorization where any item falls under dual-use or prohibited-activity restrictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound foreign direct investment into the Colombian S.A.S. must be routed through an IMC in Colombia using SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 if between banks) from the investor's overseas bank to the local bank. The payment instruction must carry the correct purpose code for direct investment in Colombia, and the beneficiary bank will request submission of the 'Declaración de Cambio de Inversión Internacional' (Form 3) or the simplified Form 3 if the investment is under the automatic authorization threshold. The bank will verify the nature of the contribution (cash versus in-kind), the source of funds, the beneficial ownership statement, and the value of the issued shares. Liquid injected capital may initially rest in a non-interest bearing escrow/current account pending completion of the companies registration and the issuance of a certificate of exchange registration by Banco de la República. Bank transfers must identify the Colombian S.A.S. RUT number and the exact corporate reference to avoid classification as a loan subject to Form 3 D-1.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for procurement of surplus aircraft parts from overseas suppliers are executed through SWIFT MT103 over correspondent bank relationships with the local commercial bank, or through the documentary letter of credit ('Carta de Crédito Comercial') governed by ICC UCP600 rules. The invoice, bill of lading/airway bill, insurance certificate, and any airworthiness release (FAA 8130-3/EASA Form 1) must be presented through the local bank for compliance screening. For parts purchases requiring escrow, the local bank or an authorized trust company may open a controlled escrow account in COP or USD, disbursing only upon delivery confirmation by a certified aviation inspector. Payments directly to offshore escrow agents are permissible when licensed under Colombian exchange regulations and supported by foreign exchange Form 4. Delayed settlements through open-account terms are permitted for trade credit of up to 6 months without automatic prior central bank authorization.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/COP FX Forwards executed with an authorized local commercial bank under the official foreign exchange market
Non-deliverable Forwards (NDF) with non-resident financial institutions where permissible under Banco de la República's foreign exchange derivative rules for real trade exposure only
Cross-currency swaps between USD and COP for the purpose of hedging the aircraft parts financing principal and interest flows
Covered foreign exchange options purchased from an authorized IMC for protection against adverse USD/COP movements during the import/export cycle

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Mercantile Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Commercial Chamber of the entity's registered address)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March each year (covers the immediately preceding fiscal year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing accrues daily default interest (current rate set by the Chamber) and an additional 10% late surcharge; continued non-renewal for several months leads to suspension of the mercantile registration and ultimately administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Declaration (Declaración Anual de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, within the first quarter of the calendar year, on the date fixed by DIAN (typically 31 March)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or late filing imposes a penalty between 1,500 and 2,500 UVT under Article 631-5 of the Tax Code; incorrect data may additionally classify as an inaccuracy subject to further sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Filing (Estados Financieros presentados a la Asamblea)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (deposited with the renewal package)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements for the prior year must be approved by shareholders no later than 31 March; filing with the Chamber accompanies the renewal within the same window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file financial reports prevents the Chamber from recording the necessary disclosures; the company remains in default and may be fined by the Superintendencia de Sociedades and may lose access to credit/statutory certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Auditor (Revisor Fiscal) Opinion & Shareholders' Meeting Minutes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered with the corporate books; available for inspection by DIAN and Superintendencia
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Meeting approving the annual accounts must be convened within 3 months of fiscal year-end; auditor's report must be integrated before approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: For entities exceeding the audit threshold, absence or late delivery of the Revisor Fiscal's opinion invalidates the approval of financial statements and triggers director liability and fines under the Companies Act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of Civil Aviation Spare Parts Distribution Licence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: UAEAC (Unidad Administrativa Especial de Aeronáutica Civil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual renewal, typically within 30 days before the expiration date designated by the UAEAC; calendar alignment with the business registry renewal is recommended
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Lapse of the licence suspends operations of the aviation spares trading activity; late renewal incurs surcharges; continued unlicensed operation can result in administrative fines and revocation of the commercial authorisation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada must appoint a statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) when, as of 31 December of the prior year, total assets or gross income exceed 5,000 UVT (approx. COP 235,000,000 for 2024); the auditor is also mandatory for public interest entities, financial institutions or when the company's articles specifically require it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: All Colombian companies must apply the accounting standards issued under Law 1314/2009: full IFRS for larger entities and IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities (SMEs) for entities meeting the SME classification; standards are codified by Decree 2420/2015 and subsequent amendments.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Shareholders must keep the UBO register updated with every any change in ownership or control; annually, the company must confirm the information through DIAN's UBO module, declaring whether any modification occurred during the preceding year. Unreported changes expose the company and its representatives to the penalties set out in Article 631-5 of the Tax Code.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Libro de Junta Directiva)
Revisor Fiscal Register (when statutory audit applies)
